browserJourneys.name: Desktop Workshop golden path and recovery
browserJourneys.evidence: At 1440x900, the production artifact resumed directly into the Workshop with HTTP 200, no horizontal overflow, no console/page errors, and no failed requests. The automated journey met all three original NPCs, preserved an item after a wrong pairing, assembled the raid across reload, earned the open chair, persisted joined=true, and displayed The First Raid hook. The arrival and assembled screenshots were visually inspected with no material composition or readability defect.

browserJourneys.name: Mobile reduced-motion and keyboard Workshop
browserJourneys.evidence: At 390x844 with reduced motion, scrollWidth equaled innerWidth (390), the Workshop remained fully visible, arrow-key facing and Enter activation worked, and the role reward entered inventory. The screenshot was visually inspected with no material crop, overlap, or readability defect.

browserJourneys.name: Portal-style sandboxed iframe with CSP
browserJourneys.evidence: A sandbox=allow-scripts allow-same-origin iframe loaded /rg-tlm-game/ under the configured Caddy CSP, continued into data-room=workshop, and reported no console errors, page errors, HTTP failures, or failed requests.

limitations: An initial five-worker E2E attempt encountered runtime Chromium target crashes and navigation timeouts (9/14 passed); the complete suite was rerun serially in the same browser runtime and all 14/14 scenarios passed.

Docker and Caddy executables were unavailable, so CSP behavior was exercised with a local static harness applying the exact Caddyfile policy; the shared hosting files themselves are unchanged from the verified base.
summary: Passed: the pinned candidate adds a complete, recoverable, autosaving Workshop chapter with three original role NPCs, an explicit place-at-the-table ending and The First Raid hook, while preserving prior chapters, published output parity, initial-load deferral, iframe/CSP compatibility, and shared hosting configuration.
